an4.245:1.1: sikkhānisaṃsamidaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati paññuttaraṃ vimuttisāraṃ satādhipateyyaṃ.
an4.245:1.3: idha bhikkhave mayā sāvakānaṃ abhisamācārikā sikkhā paññattā appasannānaṃ pasādāya pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya
an4.245:1.4: yathā yathā bhikkhave mayā sāvakānaṃ abhisamācārikā sikkhā paññattā appasannānaṃ pasādāya pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya tathā tathā so tassā sikkhāya akhaṇḍakārī hoti acchiddakārī asabalakārī akammāsakārī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an4.245:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave mayā sāvakānaṃ ādibrahmacariyakā sikkhā paññattā sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāya
an4.245:2.2: yathā yathā bhikkhave mayā sāvakānaṃ ādibrahmacariyakā sikkhā paññattā sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāya tathā tathā so tassā sikkhāya akhaṇḍakārī hoti acchiddakārī asabalakārī akammāsakārī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an4.245:3.2: idha bhikkhave mayā sāvakānaṃ dhammā desitā sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāya
an4.245:3.3: yathā yathā bhikkhave mayā sāvakānaṃ dhammā desitā sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāya tathā tathā sabbe te dhammā paññāya samavekkhitā honti
an4.245:4.2: idha bhikkhave mayā sāvakānaṃ dhammā desitā sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāya
an4.245:4.3: yathā yathā bhikkhave mayā sāvakānaṃ dhammā desitā sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāya tathā tathā sabbe te dhammā vimuttiyā phusitā honti
an4.245:5.2: iti aparipūraṃ vā abhisamācārikaṃ sikkhaṃ paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā abhisamācārikaṃ sikkhaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmīti ajjhattaṃyeva sati supaṭṭhitā hoti
an4.245:5.3: iti aparipūraṃ vā ādibrahmacariyakaṃ sikkhaṃ paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā ādibrahmacariyakaṃ sikkhaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmīti ajjhattaṃyeva sati supaṭṭhitā hoti
an4.245:5.4: iti asamavekkhitaṃ vā dhammaṃ tattha tattha paññāya samavekkhissāmi samavekkhitaṃ vā dhammaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmīti ajjhattaṃyeva sati supaṭṭhitā hoti
an4.245:5.5: iti aphusitaṃ vā dhammaṃ vimuttiyā phusissāmi phusitaṃ vā dhammaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmīti ajjhattaṃyeva sati supaṭṭhitā hoti
an4.245:5.7: sikkhānisaṃsamidaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vuccati paññuttaraṃ vimuttisāraṃ satādhipateyyanti
an4.245:5.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttanti.
